wholePhysicalScope: Native OpenStreetMap alignment, survey-published seating and stage dimensions, and original Mapzen terrain values over the hill.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the stepped cavea, orchestra, raised stage and surviving column groups.
limitations: The standing and restored theatre is represented as a ruin. Stone fractures, angles and individual column remnants are approximated using the cleared view and published dimensions.
The associated archaeological precinct and inaccessible spaces below the stands are outside scope.
